prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: A school sports day with football, basketball, baseball and racket games in separate areas. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "Sport Day". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Sport day, football, soccer, team.
Basketball, baseball, one big dream.
Tennis, badminton, hit the ball.
Catch and kick, one game for all.
Goal and score, pass and race.
Win with care, smile face beside face.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
